circuit.name: SSS Dan Armstrong mod wiring
circuit.description:
One volume pot, one tone pot, one middle serial mix into neck and bridge.

It allows you to continuously blend or switch pickup combinations from the classic parallel Stratocaster chime into thicker, humbucker-style series tones.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="440" height="210" viewBox="0 0 440 210" role="img" aria-labelledby="selector-title selector-description">
  <title id="selector-title">5-polohový gitarový prepínač — pohľad zospodu</title>
  <desc id="selector-description">Štylizovaný spodný pohľad na otvorený gitarový blade prepínač. Dve oddelené rady po štyroch spájkovacích očkách, izolačné doštičky a kovový rám. Ovládacia páčka je na odvrátenej strane. Priehľadné pozadie a otvory. Body pripojenia A1 až A4: (112,36), (168,36), (224,36), (280,36); B1 až B4: (140,174), (196,174), (252,174), (308,174). Identifikátory kontaktov neurčujú ich elektrickú funkciu.</desc>
  <defs>
    <g id="selector-bottom-lug">
      <path d="M-10 39 V-4 Q-10 -12 -2 -12 H2 Q10 -12 10 -4 V39 Z M-4 -3 V4 A4 4 0 0 0 4 4 V-3 A4 4 0 0 0 -4 -3Z" fill="#bfc2c4" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <!-- Mounting strap lies behind the switch mechanism. -->
  <path d="M31 84 H409 Q421 84 421 96 V114 Q421 126 409 126 H31 Q19 126 19 114 V96 Q19 84 31 84Z M47 105 A7 7 0 1 0 33 105 A7 7 0 1 0 47 105Z M407 105 A7 7 0 1 0 393 105 A7 7 0 1 0 407 105Z" fill="#a7a7a7" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <!-- Solder tabs extend outward from the two insulating wafers. -->
  <g id="terminal-A1" transform="translate(112 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A2" transform="translate(168 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A3" transform="translate(224 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-A4" transform="translate(280 36)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B1" transform="translate(140 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B2" transform="translate(196 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B3" transform="translate(252 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <g id="terminal-B4" transform="translate(308 174) scale(1 -1)"><use href="#selector-bottom-lug"/></g>
  <!-- Parallel phenolic terminal boards, seen edge-on from underneath. -->
  <g fill="#c88c5c" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="82" y="65" width="276" height="24" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="82" y="121" width="276" height="24" rx="4"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#a7a7a7" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.6">
    <circle cx="112" cy="77" r="4"/><circle cx="168" cy="77" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="224" cy="77" r="4"/><circle cx="280" cy="77" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="140" cy="133" r="4"/><circle cx="196" cy="133" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="252" cy="133" r="4"/><circle cx="308" cy="133" r="4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Lower metal cage; the player-facing lever is hidden on the far side. -->
  <rect x="77" y="88" width="286" height="34" rx="5" fill="#d0d1d2" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="2.4"/>
  <path d="M105 95 H335 V115 H105Z" fill="#777b7e" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <path d="M119 99 H321 V111 H119Z" fill="#45494c"/>
  <path d="M204 95 H236 V115 H204Z" fill="#a7a7a7" stroke="#303238" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <circle cx="91" cy="105" r="4"/><circle cx="349" cy="105" r="4"/>
